parameters.query:
-- High-priority change_requests where the user hasn't given their last word yet.
-- POE binding: priority_score is the system's math, user_priority_override is
-- Darrell's prerogative — we only surface items where the override is NULL
-- (system has a suggestion, user hasn't ratified). Dispositions never include
-- 'rejected' — only pending/approved/deferred-next-cycle.
SELECT
  cr.id,
  cr.title,
  cr.summary,
  cr.priority_score,
  cr.priority_factors,
  cr.disposition,
  cr.requested_by,
  cr.project_id,
  p.name AS project_name,
  cr.created_at
FROM public.change_requests cr
LEFT JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = cr.project_id
 WHERE cr.user_priority_override IS NULL
   AND cr.disposition = 'pending'
   AND cr.priority_score IS NOT NULL
   AND cr.priority_score >= 0.6
 ORDER BY cr.priority_score DESC, cr.created_at ASC
 LIMIT 5;
